Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Age above or equal to 18 years.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is 53 years old, which satisfies the age requirement.
The patient has metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, not GEP-NETs.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Disease progression defined as follows (at least one of the following): - Radiological disease progression (according to RECIST 1.1) on an MRI or CT over the last 12 months Or - Disease progression on a somatostatin receptor-imaging, PET/CT or SPECT/CT over the last 12 months [apparition of new lesion(s) or increase in the transaxial plane diameter of more than 30% on the same imaging modality] Or - Both of the following criteria (a+b): 1. clinical progression: - sustained (for more than 2 weeks) increase of NET-specific hormonal hypersecretion related symptom frequency by 50% or, - sustained (for more than 2 weeks) increase of severity by 1 grade (according to NCI-CTCAE version 4.03). 2. biochemical progression: by increase of NET-specific tumor markers (plasma Chromogranin A, plasma NSE, urine 5-HIAA or other) in two successive measurements.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about radiological or biochemical progression specific to GEP-NETs.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Disease refractory to SSA's and/or standard systemic therapy available in Belgium at the time of inclusion criteria.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is undergoing treatment with osimertinib, but there is no information on whether the disease is refractory to SSA's or other standard therapies.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Long-acting SSAs should be discontinued at least 4 weeks before study treatment start date and, if needed, switched to short-acting analogues which should be stopped 48h before the treatment date.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not on SSAs, so this criterion does not apply.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Adequate renal function with GFR ≥ 50 mL/min/1.73m2 (evaluated by 51Cr-EDTA test).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's renal function or GFR.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Adequate bone marrow function with hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL; neutrophil ≥ 1.5·103/μL; platelet count ≥ 100·103/μL.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's bone marrow function or specific blood counts.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Adequate liver function with total bilirubin ≤ 2 x ULN and transaminases ≤ 5 x ULN, serum albumin > 3 g/dL with normal prothrombin time (> 70%).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has mild elevations in hepatic transaminase levels, but specific values and other liver function parameters are not provided.
There is no information provided about the patient's ECOG Performance Status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Women of childbearing potential and men with partners of childbearing potential must agree to use a highly-effective form of contraception for the duration of study participation and up to six months after the end of the treatment. A pregnancy test (serum) must be performed within 4 weeks prior to inclusion for every female patient of childbearing potential and it must be negative.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's use of contraception or pregnancy status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient's written informed consent obtained prior to any study procedure.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: All necessary baseline procedures should be performed within 4 weeks prior to first 177Lu-octreotate injection (D0).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the timing of baseline procedures.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The patient must have at least one target lesion fulfilling all of the below criteria: - On the 68Ga-octreotate PET/CT: tumor uptake higher than the physiological liver uptake (grade III or IV of the Rotterdam visual score) in a lesion with longest transaxial plane diameter ≥20mm (measured on the CT, part of the PET/CT); - At least one of these lesions morphologically measurable according to RECIST 1.1 and progressive on the MRI (or CT if MRI is not applicable); - Target lesion should not have been previously irradiated.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has lung adenocarcinoma, not GEP-NETs, and there is no information about 68Ga-octreotate PET/CT or target lesions.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic lung cancer, which is not resectable with curative intent.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Any major surgery within the last 6 weeks prior to inclusion in the study.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about recent major surgery.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Radiotherapy, chemotherapy, embolization, mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR)-inhibitors, receptor tyrosine-kinase inhibitors, interferon, or other investigational therapy within the last 12 weeks prior to inclusion in the study.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is currently undergoing treatment with osimertinib, which is a receptor tyrosine-kinase inhibitor.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diffuse bone marrow infiltration on the baseline 68Ga-octreotate PET/CT confirmed by MRI.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has lung cancer, not GEP-NETs, and there is no information about 68Ga-octreotate PET/CT or bone marrow infiltration.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior external beam radiotherapy on kidneys or on more than 25% of bone marrow.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about prior radiotherapy on the kidneys or bone marrow.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with known uncontrolled brain metastases.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about brain metastases.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with a significant medical, neuro-psychiatric, or surgical condition, currently uncontrolled by treatment, which, in the investigator's opinion, may interfere with completion of the study.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about significant uncontrolled medical, neuro-psychiatric, or surgical conditions.
There is no information provided about the patient's pregnancy or lactation status.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Women of childbearing potential and men with partners of childbearing potential refusing an adequate contraception.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's use of contraception or refusal of contraception.

Recap: The patient does not meet the inclusion criteria for histology-proven advanced GEP-NETs and has violated the exclusion criterion related to recent treatment with a receptor tyrosine-kinase inhibitor. Other criteria remain unclear due to insufficient data.
